{{Conjecture|legends}}
At some point between [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]] and [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]],<ref name="Date">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' establishes that, with respect to approximately one [[Standard year/Legends|year]] after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]&mdash;which the book places in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]]&mdash;[[Operation Ram's Head]] took place "over the next year." Thus, the operation occurred between [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]] and [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]]. As ''[[Star Wars: X-Wing Tour of Duty: B-Wing]]'' takes place after Operation Ram's Head and before the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] established [[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base]] on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]], a process that ''The New Essential Chronology'' places between 2 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|ABY]] and [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], the events of the [[Star Wars video games|game]], including the [[attack on a TIE staging area]], must take place between 1 ABY at the earliest and 3 ABY at the latest.</ref> a '''battle''' took place near [[Pii II]] between the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="Tour">''[[Star Wars: X-Wing Tour of Duty: B-Wing]]''</ref>
